scope: Real Chrome modules/IndexedDB with simulated projections and proof callback; all /api network blocked; not real backend reconciliation

checks.name: sync self message alone never acknowledges original Outbox
peer forged clientId never clears or hides local pending
snapshot history is not all-new local unread
new peer delta adds unread and structured mention once
currently read conversation clears old and new local unread
own delta and old edits do not create new unread
minimal global object clears body and sidecars
known global cannot be reopened by same old newer or unknown source
fresh forward stays in RAM but durable view only contains placeholder
late exact source refresh cannot reopen current global row
exact original body route and owner proof clears only acknowledged Outbox
same clientId with changed text admission or route never acknowledges
foreign sender and missing proof keep original queue
Engine callback sees original body and latest-queue CAS rejects changed payload
durable global stamp is terminal even for higher owner revision
single retained holder never resurrects global body
